title: Austronesian Comparative Dictionary
cite_as: Robert Blust and Stephen Trussel 2020. The Austronesian Comparative Dictionary. Web edition; CLDF dataset v2.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.14608975.
kind_of_work: set-centric comparative dictionary of the Austronesian family, as a CLDF Wordlist (lexibank, pyetymdict-style tables)
holder: Robert Blust (with Stephen Trussel), as the ACD's author; the CLDF conversion is by Forkel and Smith
glottolog: The release maps its languages with Glottolog v5.1; wety's catalogs read Glottolog 5.3.

curation.language_map: etc/languages.json (from etc/languages.reviewed.json and the catalog bundle)
curation.orthography_profile: none yet: ACD writes schwa as e where Wiktionary writes ə (acd-3)
